title: FitTrack Ad From Supplied Screenshots
tests: Uses supplied app screenshots faithfully in a finished landscape ad rather than inventing replacement screens.

faults.what: Both portrait screenshots are enlarged and severely cropped to fill the widescreen frame, hiding their headers and cutting off lower content rather than presenting the screens readably.
The audio transcript reports speech, "すべての人に", violating the explicit no-voiceover requirement.
The ending places a small gray FitTrack label over the still-cropped workout screen, resulting in a weak, cluttered brand finish.

judge.summary: The 10-second widescreen clip shows home before workout and ends with FitTrack, but severe screenshot cropping and unwanted speech require a redo.

must_haves.item: The final video is 10 seconds long and landscape 16:9.
must_haves.why: The supplied duration is 10 seconds and the output frames are landscape 16:9.

must_haves.item: The supplied FitTrack home screenshot appears before the supplied workout screenshot.
must_haves.why: Home-screen content appears at 1.3 and 3.8 seconds, followed by workout content at 6.3 and 8.8 seconds.

must_haves.item: Both screenshots remain recognizable and readable, without invented replacement UI.
must_haves.why: Visible text matches the supplied screenshots, but extreme cropping removes the headers and multiple rows, leaving neither screen fully readable.
FitTrack is clearly legible in the 8.8-second ending frame.

must_haves.item: An upbeat instrumental track is audible, with no voiceover.
must_haves.why: The provided sound transcript explicitly reports speech; the instrumental track's mood cannot be assessed from the supplied information.
